SYMPTOM: Claude CLI crashes after some time of use; requires full computer restart to fix; ulimit -n 2147483646 doesn't help long-term
CAUSE: Every user prompt spawns a bun process for hooks; curation at session-end spawns bun + Agent SDK which spawns Claude subprocess — fd leaks and zombie processes accumulate over time on macOS (default ulimit 256 makes it worse)
FIX (INCOMPLETE): session-start.sh and user-prompt.sh rewritten as pure curl/python shell scripts in ~/.config/hooks/ — but session was interrupted before finishing pre-compact and session-end hooks
PREVENT: Must complete shell script rewrite for ALL 4 hooks, especially pre-compact and session-end which are the heavy ones (they invoke bun for curation)
NEXT: Write pre-compact.sh and session-end.sh as curl scripts that POST to the server's checkpoint endpoint
